items.name: phani06041/Text-based-adventure-game-with-GUI-
items.description: DESCRIPTION The title we have chosen is the Text-Based Adventure Game with a GUI. The game allows the user to freely move around an 8x8 map by using fixed control buttons (a, w, d, i, j, etc.) for moving, turning, collecting items and other features. There are fixed boundaries around the maps which do not allow the player to trespass. There are many Non-Playable-Characters (NPC’s) residing on the map who interact with the user by providing a lore about the map and characters in general. We have also developed a few mini-games in addition to exploring the main map, which can be played by the user for a more engaging experience DESCRIPTION OF GUI COMPONENTS:  We have used the Turtle module to design the main map and minigame maps, colour the visuals, NPC’s, items and various other things. The entire project revolves around the GUI component. The Turtle module also controls the movement of the player and NPC’s, drawing of the maps, collection and movement of the in-game items, etc BASIC INPUT AND OUTPUT DATA:  Most inputs are in the form of pressing of the assigned keyboard keys for movement and other functions. These keys immediately cause interaction with the game and invoke the required commands. They do not need to be typed in a designated area of the screen and can be pressed at will. Some inputs, however, are required to be typed into the IDLE Screen for a few mini-games. The outputs are immediately noticeable in the form of the changing map, position of the player, setting up of NPC’s and mini-games, etc on the Turtle Window. Warnings, character dialogues and other texts are displayed in the Python Shell. Since the project almost entirely revolves around a GUI, the outputs would be more visual-based than text-based CORE PROGRAM AND FUNCTIONS:  The core program includes various user-defined functions which allow the user to move around using keyboard bindings (turtle.onkey()). An infinite loop restricts the user from travelling beyond the maps. During the minigames, the main map interactions are restricted by the use of counter variables and nested loops. Various “turtles'' are also created and hidden (turtle.turtle(), turtle.hideturtle()) during the course of the game. The Time module is also imported to keep track of how long the user took to finish the mini-games and hence decide if they won or lost. Functions like turtle.fillcolor(), turtle.end_fill(), turtle.setpos(), turtle.up(), etc. have been used to make the game visually appealing.

items.description: CyberOps is a full-stack, browser-first cybersecurity learning game that teaches defensive concepts through interactive, scenario-driven play. Built with HTML/CSS/JavaScript (frontend) and Python (FastAPI) (backend), It uses Ollama AI to dynamically produce narrative text, illustrative images, NPC dialogue, and adaptive challenges.

items.name: pat-togonon/Stanford-RPG
items.description: A dating role-play game where players interact with NPCs shaped by real psychological patterns (like avoidant, anxious, and secure attachment). With dating stage-specific dialogues and emotional arcs, players not only experience romance, but also healing, reflection and the consequences of emotional choices.

items.name: m3t4knight/StardewGPT
items.description: Stardew GPT brings your favorite Stardew Valley NPCs to life using real-time AI conversations. Whether you're chatting with Abigail about amethysts or asking Shane how he's really doing, this mod lets you engage in dynamic, immersive dialogue that goes far beyond the base game.

items.name: Esmer615/Neural_Killer
items.description: AI-driven murder mystery game built with Streamlit, DeepSeek LLM, and MiniMax TTS. Players interrogate 5 AI NPCs via free-form dialogue, unlock clues through a dual-layer trigger system ([UNLOCK_CLUE]/[CONFIRM]), and solve a brain-computer interface murder case with 3D card-flip reveals.

items.name: nemchuk1998/Hack-N-Slash
items.description: 3D action hack-n-slash game created by team of 5 people during the second year of studies.During the project i was responsible for such mechanics as: 1)Inventory system 2)NPC interaction sytem 3)Dialogue system 4)UI programming. Project is still in progress

items.name: kimsiunm4/AI-Cinematic-Mod
items.description: AI Cinematic Creator is an advanced Minecraft Fabric mod that lets players write stories and dialogues inside the game. Using AI, it automatically generates NPC actions, character animations, cinematic camera paths, scene transitions, emotions, and complete cutscenes, making Minecraft movie creation faster and easier than ever.

items.name: astcode/simvibe3d
items.description: SimVibe 3D is a narrative-driven AI-powered 3D game prototype where conversational NPCs with persistent memory and dynamic behavior guide the player through an immersive, story-rich cyberpunk world. It blends spatial interaction, quest logic, and natural dialogue to create an experience that feels alive and responsive rather than scripted.

items.name: Gibberlings3/BG1NPC
items.description: The BG1 NPC Project adds a great deal of content by expanding the depth of character and levels of interaction with the NPCs from the Baldur's Gate game. Requires Tutu, BGT, or BGEE.

items.name: Lim-Young/GameplayInputSystem
items.description: A global input listening system based on GameplayTag, integrated with an interaction module that supports the creation and management of various custom interaction events. It meets the needs of QTE inputs, NPC interactions, and more, offering high extensibility and flexibility.

items.name: ViLD-Store/vs_interactions
items.description: vs_interactions is a flexible library that enables dynamic interactions with in-game entities like NPCs, props, and objects using a modern UI. It supports customizable options such as missions, events, and actions, with features like distance-based triggers, conditional logic, and icon-driven menus, enhancing immersive gameplay experiences.

items.name: PranavMishra17/SoulEngine
items.description: Stateless NPC intelligence with layered memory cycles, personality evolution, voice interaction, and MCP-based agency in game environments.

items.name: ShiJbey/SocialSimGameDevTools
items.description: List of tools for building socially-aware characters, character relationships, and NPC social interactions in games

items.name: opencodeiiita/Questline
items.description: An open-source Unity 3D game that teaches quest systems, NPC interactions, and real-world game development workflows.

items.name: skipdudes/AdventureGame
items.description: An adventure game based on models of interactions with NPCs with specific motivations

items.name: dzuqe/npc
items.description: simple npc game interactions using a stateful contract and atomic transfers

items.name: LiveBacteria/GPTales-InteractiveNPC
items.description: GPTales-InteractiveNPCs with Cardinal System revolutionizes game projects by utilizing GPT technology and the Cardinal System, creating immersive, responsive NPCs that dynamically adapt to player actions. Experience lifelike interactions and narratives in a vibrant, evolving game world.

items.name: lakshyajain-0291/Vindication
items.description: ⚔️ The Vindication: Dive into a text-based historical fiction adventure! 🏰 Built in C, this open-ended game world features 🎮 mini-games, 🤝 NPC interactions, 📜 quests, 🖼️ terminal ASCII graphics, and 🎵 immersive audio. Easily expand the experience with modifiable JSON game content! 🚀

items.name: sakith03/TimeLoopEscape-3D-Game
items.description: A 3D time-loop escape simulation game where players must find the exit before time runs out. NPCs navigate the environment using BFS and A* pathfinding algorithms, integrated through a graph-based node system with GraphQL-based data interaction.

items.name: drHaxx/Roblox-starter-kit
items.description: This is a starter kit for anyone making a Roblox game. This includes scripts for Player Movements, Health, Inventory system, UI, NPC interactions, a Combat system, a Lvl system, and Sound and Music

items.name: oelsaye/MultiTycoon
items.description: Multi-Tycoon is a retro-style tycoon game programmed in C++, utilizing the SFML library. Multi-Tycoon allows users to experience 4 different types of tycoons, restaurant, lemonade stand, food truck, as well as casino. The game allows user recipe-design, interactions with movement-animated NPCs, and fulfilling food orders in a queue.

items.name: TheIronMarx/Desynchronosis
items.description: Desynchronosis is an RPG puzzle game of some sort involving time manipulation and NPC interaction.

items.name: ZyranCZ/Tap-to-Move
items.description: You can now Tap to Move, the game hhas functional pathfinding and functional interactions. To avoid unwanted interactions midway, interactions are limited to only actually single tapping the object/npc, so that you can Hold Touch and keep moving.

items.name: gandazgul/caper
items.description: A point-and-click adventure engine built on Phaser 3. Caper provides the reusable systems for a Humongous-style adventure game: walking, one-click interaction, declarative props, inventory, NPC/cast behavior, weather, cutscenes, transitions, UI helpers, and engine-owned state primitives.

items.name: madelinben/world-sim
items.description: A TypeScript web game that brings an RPG-inspired 16px world simulation to life. Explore a dynamic top down world filled with NPCs, POIs, structures, and thrilling adventures. Customize your character, manage your inventory, and immerse yourself in rich interactions and procedurally generated gameplay.

items.name: aipower404/NPT-FREE-GAME
items.description: Interactive LLM Powered NPCs, is an open-source project that completely transforms your interaction with non-player characters (NPCs) in any game!

items.name: kamalzada37/Legendary-Sword-Adventure
items.description: 2D Unity adventure game with NPC interaction, combat system, and level progression.

items.name: noswear922/QB-NPC-Messaging-Script
items.description: This script enables players to send messages to a Discord webhook through interactions with NPCs (non-playable characters) in GTA V roleplay servers using FiveM. It is designed to be used for businesses or various jobs within the game.

items.name: valentinshenfeld/skyrift-server
items.description: ⚔️ Backend of a multiplayer RPG that handles game world simulation, player progression, combat, quests, inventory, and NPC interactions.

items.name: RejectSoul/Bombing_the_Land
items.description: A story-driven spy prison escape game with stealth mechanics, NPC interactions, and a deep conspiracy to uncover. Escape in 12 days or face the consequences.

items.name: cammiele1996/CPP-Text-Based-Game
items.description: A text-based adventure RPG built in C++. Wake up in a tavern with no memory, piece together your identity through NPC interactions and quests, gear up, and face the dragon. Features OOP design, dynamic enemy spawning, difficulty scaling, and a branching quest system. WIP.

items.name: mingxi7077/Minecraft-bonfire-concept
items.description: Bonfire is a long-term immersive social game project built on Minecraft, focused on NPC interaction, role-based professions, player-driven cities, logistics systems, and emotional social storytelling across a persistent open world.

items.name: GideonMire/LOST-AMONG-THE-STARS
items.description: Lost Among The Stars is a story-driven 2D space RPG featuring exploration, narrative choices, dynamic events, five handcrafted levels, NPC interactions, and an in-game currency system as you uncover mysteries across alien worlds.

items.name: aladinovitch/ArenaReplayWatcher
items.description: WoW AddOn designed to facilitate the spectating of PvP Arena matches 2V2, 3V3 and SoloQ, for WotLK (3.3.5a) client. This tool enables users to initiate spectator mode via interaction with a dedicated in-game NPC.

items.name: Indicaza/shard-api
items.description: This backend system manages the game state of the Shard.  GPT calls control the state of the shard world by seeding the procedural NPC generation and interaction system.  Managing the world state, and generating random quests and events.

items.name: gammadatalattice/sp3arparvus-v5.2.1
items.description: Sp3arParvus v5.2.1 is a performance-optimized Lua execution suite engineered for environment analysis, client-side diagnostics, and runtime interaction testing. Built with a lightweight footprint, it provides developers and testers with real-time visibility into local game instances, object properties, and viewport rendering behavior.

items.name: aaron-hamil5/2DAdventureGame
items.description: Project Overview In this tutorial, we will begin a completely new project; specifically, a 2D adventure game in which the player controls an alien character, exploring and navigating a dangerous world complete with quests and interactive elements. In this project we will cover the following topics: • 2D characters and player movement • Assembling complex and multipart characters • Level design • 2D Physics and collision detection The assets for this project can be found under the Project Companion Files module in the 2D Adventure Game folder on Moodle. Adventure games require the player to use their cunning, dexterity, mental sharpness, and acumen to make progress. Such games feature dangerous obstacles, challenging missions, and character interaction, as opposed to all-out action like many first-person shooter games. Our adventure game will be no exception. In this game, the player moves around using the keyboard arrows or W, A, S, D keys. Furthermore, they can jump with the spacebar and interact with characters simply by approaching them. During the game, the player will be tasked with a mission from an NPC character to collect an ancient gem hidden somewhere within a level. The player must then navigate dangerous obstacles in search of the gem, and then finally collect it before returning to the NPC, completing the game.

items.name: phani-sharma/Multiplayer_FPS
items.description: This project relies on the implementation of the multiplayer first person shooter game using Navmesh for enemy pathfinding AI, object pooling  to  build more efficient game save memory and CPU and also Photon unity networking (PUN) for online multiplayer. AI in gaming refers to responsive and adaptive video game experiences. These AI-powered interactive experiences are usually generated via non-player characters, or NPCs, that act intelligently or creatively, as if controlled by a human game-player. Object Pooling is a great way to optimize your projects and lower the burden that is placed on the CPU when having to rapidly create and destroy game objects. Photon Unity Networking (PUN) is a Unity package for multiplayer games. Flexible matchmaking gets your players into rooms where objects can be synced over the network. RPCs, Custom Properties or "low level" Photon events are just some of the features.

2389736818/Zombie-Outline
items.description: Zombie Outline Version: 1.0  Description: This mod is based on the old Zombie Horde mod, but with many more features. The ZH mod gives you a nice co-op environment for annihilating the mass of zombies, while this mod offers you a "smooth story", which is actually a month (31 days) of disaster which combine soldiers have to face. Aside from that, zombies yield experience, so allowing you to level up and increase your health, armor, speed, jump rate and evasion rate. There is a moderate number of different types of zombies, each of them having different stats and giving a different amount of experience when taken down. Every day it is harder and harder for the combine to complete their task as the number of zombies is increasing as well as their strength. The type of the day can either be demolition, survival or epidemic. When soldiers are caught in a demolition day, their taks is to annihilate a certain amount of zombies to complete it. There is no time limit for this. In the survival days, if they stay alive a certain amount of time (without all being dead at the same time), they will proceed to the next day. Epidemic days are similar to demolition days, only then you do not want to get hit by a zombie, as the virus that is spread in the air will hurt you through the wound more than you think it will. Ocasionally (in certain days), combine soldiers have to face motherzombies. In the demolition and epidemic days, they will come right after the number of regular zombies reaches zero, while in survival days they will come at the very beginning, but not required to slay them. This mod works in any way, with only bots on the human side and/or with real players. Terrorist team only contains bots as zombies. I personally haven't tested it with multiple players being on CT side at the same time, but it works quite well while I play it with bots. For a better glimpse on this mod, check this video.   Zombie Outline Commands: /zomenu - Open up the mod menu. /spawn - Spawn if you haven't, but still it is early game. /return - Don't move for 20 seconds (or so) and return to spawn point. /info - Check your information, like level, experience, etc... /zhp - Show zombie health. /zoadmin - Admin menu for this mod. /fspawn <name> - Admin command that forces a player to spawn. /freturn <name> - Admin command that forces a player to return to spawn. /zoday <value> - Admin command to set next day (must be <= 31 and > 0). /zoendday <ct/t> - Admin command to immediately end the day (argument <ct/t> = winner) /zombies <value> - Admin command to set how many zombies are left. /zoaddexp <name> <amount> - Admin command to give a player experience. /zoaddlvl <name> <amount> - Admin command to give a player level. /zoexpboost <value> - Admin command to set the experience boost.   Addon Commands: /weapons - Opets up the weapons menu. [weaponsmenu addon] /ambientson - Turns ambients (background music) on. [ambients addon] /ambientsoff - Turns ambients off. [ambients addon] /quakeon - Turns quake sounds on. [ambients addon] /quakeoff - Turns quake sounds off. [ambients addon] /spree - Check your killing/headshot spree. [ambients addon] /ambients <1/0> - Admin command to toggle ambients across whole server. [ambients addon] /quake <1/0> - Admin command to toggle quake sounds across whole server. [ambients addon] /mapstyle - Admin command to open up the mapstyle menu. [mapstyle addon]   Installation: Simply download "Zombie Outline v1.0.zip" and extract it to your game directory. You will need to download all zombie models and other materials from here. Once downloaded, simply extract it to your game directory.   I have uploaded few more addons. They are not necessary to have, but they improve the game experience and kinda add few more dimensions to the mod. If you want them, simply download and extract the "cstrike" folder from each addon (zip) to your game directory.   Addon descriptions: Serverconfigs are in my opinion very useful, as they fix precaching models in case the Zombie Outline doesn't. Also with it, you can do few more configurations such as setting cvars and execing some cfgs on map start (for example) which automates Zombie Outline preperation. Mapstyle is optional. Adds darkness (customizable) to the map and also the ability to change the sky. For this addon, you will have to download skyboxes, and extract them to your game directory. Ambients sure give good background music (from Half-Life). Quake sounds also included. Another optional, but use it (as well as the mapstyle!). ;) Weaponsmenu, optional. Nothing too special, as the name is selfexplainig. In Zombie Outline, the Blackmarket Shop, which is meant for buying weapons (I think), still isn't working as I am not sure how would I want it to be created. So think of weaponsmenu as a temporary replacement. If you want to be hardcore in game, don't use it ;)   Before you start commenting why haven't I put these as seperate plugins in new threads, well, there ARE DEFINITELY better plugins you can find that do the same thing, I have made these only for one sole purpose, and it is for improving Zombie Outline. So, I don't see the point of putting them there.   Configuration: Configuring Zombie Outline goes from "cfg/sourcemod/zo" folder. You actually edit .txt files, not .cfg files! But, if you have just installed the mod, you won't have the .txt files. To generate them, you will have to run the mod once on your server, and after that, close the server and get back. Download the "cfg example for v1.0.zip" for more details. Serverconfigs can be configured from "cfg/sourcemod/serverconfigs.cfg" file. There is almost no need for configuring it. But if you really want to, check the file and uhm... good luck (made this addon for some other reasons, but later found it useful here a bit). Mapstyle can be configured from "cfg/sourcemod/mapstyle.txt" and "cfg/sourcemod/mapstyle.cfg". Ambients can be configured from "cfg/sourcemod/ambients.txt". Weaponsmenu can be configured from "cfg/sourcemod/weaponsmenu.cfg".   How to play:  In order to be able to play, you must create yourself a "workspace" (basically sign yourself in the mod database, so your progress can be saved and similar). Nothing too chumpy, all you have to do is in the mod menu (default "/zomenu"), select the "Configuration" option and you will see "Create Workspace". Select it and you are ready to go! There are plenty of reasons why I didn't automate this. Debugging is the first and most important, but it is a long and boring story, so I will skip it.   Known glitches: Sometimes "/spawn" command won't let you spawn, even though you are sure you can. Just use that command few more times, or wait few seconds and then use it, and it should work. It is not a glitch, but there are 2 more commands: client "/debug" and admin "/allowdebug <name>". There is no point of using them (so far), just wanned to let you know that they exist too.   If you have any questions, problems or anything else, leave a reply here or a comment on the youtube video.

items.name: michellepine/FearlessFlightCodeDraft
items.description: -----------------------------------FEARLESS FLIGHT----------------------------------- --------------------------------a game by Michelle Pine------------------------------   ---------------------------DOWNLOAD & OPENING INSTRUCTIONS --------------------------  To play FEARLESS FLIGHT, download the entire "Fearless_Flight" folder as a zip. Unzip (decompress) the folder and open the .pde file called "Fearless_Flight" in the  Processing editor. Run the sketch using the play button in the Processing editor. You  will need keyboard and mouse controls. The game window can be closed at any time  using the ESC key.  From there, follow the instructions on screen, or use the instructions below.   -------------------------------------HOW TO PLAY-------------------------------------  Press any key to exit the opening title and access the menu. From there, use the  mouse to pick any of the customizable options. A plane must be either red, blue, or  green. Easy mode is characterized by slower game play. The harder the mode, the  faster objects will move. Pressing B at any time will return you to this menu.   Once you customize your gameplay, press ENTER to begin the tutorial. The tutorial can  be skipped by pressing ENTER again. You can read through the entire tutorial, or  switch between the tutorial screens, by pressing the right and left arrow keys.  During the tutorial, you may test out your plane's capabilities, which include moving up and down using the mouse location, and firing bullets using the SPACEBAR.  Once you leave the tutorial screen, gameplay begins, and enemies will begin to spawn.  Use the SPACEBAR to shoot enemies. Shooting a bird will deduct points from your  score. Shooting a plane will add points to your score. Being hit by either will kill your plane and cause the game to end. If you lose, your score is still saved in the high score list if it is high enough to make the ranks.   The game runs on a timer, so if you play for long enough, you can win. If you win, your plane will reach the Island and the game will end. Your score will be added to  the high score list if it is high enough. From there, you can play again by pressing  any key. You will be redirected to the menu to customize your options again.   ---------------------------------------CREDITS --------------------------------------  --TUTORIAL ON EASING FROM HERE: https://processing.org/examples/easing.html  --PLANE SOUND BY: Mike Koenig, http://soundbible.com/1305-Cargo-Plane-Cabin-Ambiance.html     Title: Cargo Plane Cabin Ambiance     Uploaded: 01.11.10 | License: Attribution 3.0 | Recorded by Mike Koenig   --EXPLOSION SOUND BY: Mike Koenig, http://soundbible.com/538-Blast.html      Title: Blast     Uploaded: 06.09.09 | License: Attribution 3.0 | Recorded by Mike Koenig |     *used with an Attribution 3.0 license  --TUTORIAL ON SAVING HIGH SCORES FROM HERE: https://forum.processing.org/two/ discussion/19719/saving-a-highscore  --FREEWARE FONTS:      *"Startled" font by Gaunt Fonts at http://www.fontspace.com/gaut-fonts/startling-       font         *"Langdon" Font by xlntelecom at https://www.fontsquirrel.com/fonts/langdon  --MUSIC generated with Apple GarageBand and Apple Loops  --IMAGES created using Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop

items.name: NILKANTHABAG/PUBG-EDA-Hackathon
items.description: PUBG Data Description In a PUBG game, up to 100 players start in each match (matchId). Players can be on teams (groupId) which get ranked at the end of the game (winPlacePerc) based on how many other teams are still alive when they are eliminated. In game, players can pick up different munitions, revive downed-but-not-out (knocked) teammates, drive vehicles, swim, run, shoot, and experience all of the consequences -- such as falling too far or running themselves over and eliminating themselves. You are provided with a large number of anonymized PUBG game stats, formatted so that each row contains one player's post-game stats. The data comes from matches of all types: solos, duos, squads, and custom; there is no guarantee of there being 100 players per match, nor at most 4 players per group. File descriptions data.csv - 151MB Data fields DBNOs - Number of enemy players knocked. assists - Number of enemy players this player damaged that were killed by teammates. boosts - Number of boost items used. damageDealt - Total damage dealt. Note: Self inflicted damage is subtracted. headshotKills - Number of enemy players killed with headshots. heals - Number of healing items used. Id - Player’s Id killPlace - Ranking in match of number of enemy players killed. killPoints - Kills-based external ranking of players. (Think of this as an Elo ranking where only kills matter.) If there is a value other than -1 in rankPoints, then any 0 in killPoints should be treated as a “None”. killStreaks - Max number of enemy players killed in a short amount of time. kills - Number of enemy players killed. longestKill - Longest distance between player and player killed at time of death. This may be misleading, as downing a player and driving away may lead to a large longestKill stat. matchDuration - Duration of match in seconds. matchId - ID to identify matches. There are no matches that are in both the training and testing set. matchType - String identifying the game mode that the data comes from. The standard modes are “solo”, “duo”, “squad”, “solo-fpp”, “duo-fpp”, and “squad-fpp”; other modes are from events or custom matches. rankPoints - Elo-like ranking of players. This ranking is inconsistent and is being deprecated in the API’s next version, so use with caution. Value of -1 takes the place of “None”. revives - Number of times this player revived teammates. rideDistance - Total distance traveled in vehicles measured in meters. roadKills - Number of kills while in a vehicle. swimDistance - Total distance traveled by swimming measured in meters. teamKills - Number of times this player killed a teammate. vehicleDestroys - Number of vehicles destroyed. walkDistance - Total distance traveled on foot measured in meters. weaponsAcquired - Number of weapons picked up. winPoints - Win-based external ranking of players. (Think of this as an Elo ranking where only winning matters.) If there is a value other than -1 in rankPoints, then any 0 in winPoints should be treated as a “None”. groupId - ID to identify a group within a match. If the same group of players plays in different matches, they will have a different groupId each time. numGroups - Number of groups we have data for in the match. maxPlace - Worst placement we have data for in the match. This may not match with numGroups, as sometimes the data skips over placements. winPlacePerc - The target of prediction. This is a percentile winning placement, where 1 corresponds to 1st place, and 0 corresponds to last place in the match. It is calculated off of maxPlace, not numGroups, so it is possible to have missing chunks in a match. Link-https://www.kaggle.com/c/pubg-finish-placement-prediction/

items.name: thatikondasandeep/Skycast-puzzle
items.description: Gaurav is a 12 year old student who’s fractured his leg and lower back in a bicycle accident and  is on a bed rest for the next 2 months. He keeps himself busy by watching television on his  Skycast DTH. While watching the television, one day he decided to play a small game, where  he has to identify the minimum number of clicks required to surf a given set of channels in a  sequence. He quickly decided that it makes for an interesting problem to solve using a software  program, (oh, forgot to tell you that he likes to code when he is not busy with his school work).    Your task is to write the software program (using any of the programming language choices  given), before Gaurav can do it himself, we think he is going to take 2 hours, so you think you  can beat the 12 year old in solving this, we think so! Your time starts now!    Obviously the program has to take the following instructions and constraints into account.    Instructions    There are 13 buttons on his remote: 10 buttons for the numbers (0-9), an "Up Channel" button,  a "Down Channel" button, and a "Back" button:    ● The number buttons allow you to jump directly to a specific channel. (Ex: to go to  channel 63 by typing “6”, “3”.)  ● The "Up Channel" button increments the current channel to the next higher viewable  channel, unless the current channel is the highest viewable channel, in which case it  rolls over to the lowest viewable channel.  ● The "Down Channel" button decrements to the next lower viewable channel, unless the  current channel is the lowest viewable channel, in which case it rolls over to the highest  viewable channel.  ● The "Back" button reverts to whatever channel was on the television before the current  channel. (Ex: If channel 1 is viewed, then channel 100, then when Back is pressed, the  television will go to channel 1.)    Gaurav can get from one channel to the next in one of the two ways:  ● Clicking any combination of "Up Channel", "Down Channel", and "Back" buttons.  ● Keying in the numbers to the channel. Gaurav will never combine "Back" and number  buttons when moving from one channel to the next.    Gaurav’s parents have set some parental control on some channels on Gaurav's television.  These channels are not viewable, so they are skipped by the "Up Channel" and "Down  Channel" buttons.    Given a list of channels to view, the lowest channel, the highest channel, and a list of blocked  channels, your program should return the minimum number of clicks necessary to get  through all the shows that Gaurav would like to watch.        Input Your program has to take 3 inputs for each test case, the first input will contain two space  delimited numbers, these will form the lowest channel and the highest channel. The next input  will contain the number of blocked channels followed by sequence of blocked channels (again  space delimited). The first number in the input will contain the number of inputs The last input is  the sequence of channels that Gaurav must view (in order). Again, the first number will contain  the number of inputs    Notes:    ● Unit tests are mandatory, so please ensure that the code you submit has automated unit  tests and you adopt TDD principles (as it applies to this problem statement)    Sample Input    Test Case #1  1 20  2 18 19  5 15 14 17 1 17    Test Case #2  103 108  1 104  5 105 106 107 103 105    Test Case #3  1 100  4 78 79 80 3  8 10 13 13 100 99 98 77 81    Test Case #4  1 200  0  4 1 100 1 101    Sample Output    Output for Test Case #1: 7  Output for Test Case #2: 8  Output for Test Case #3: 12  Output for Test Case #4: 7    Constraints  ● The lowest channel on the television will be greater than 0, and less than or equal to  10,000.  ● The highest channel on the television will be greater than or equal to lowest channel,  and less than or equal to 10,000.  ● The list of channels that are blocked on Gaurav's television. All the channels in this list  will be valid channels (greater than or equal to lowest channel, less than or equal to highest channel). Duplicates may be ignored. The blocked list can be maximum of 40  channels.  ● The sequence that Gaurav must view contains between 1 and 50 elements, inclusive. All  channels in this sequence are not in the blocked list and are between lowest channel  and highest channel, inclusive.

items.name: bell-kevin/HangmanWithDictionaryFile
items.description: Hangman With Dictionary File. You created a Wheel of Fortune project in Ch 9 in the previous Java course. In that version, you hard-coded the array of letters for the word the user needed to guess. In this version (called Hangman because it's shorter for this long project name), you will write a series of 6 words into a file which will serve as the dictionary of words for the game. When the project starts, that dictionary will be read into an array of words, and a random number will select which one is used in the play of the game. The rest of the game is the same as the project in Ch 9.  Before you begin, be sure to look at the Try It Out exercises in the additional reading in Canvas, "Reading about File Processing".  The file for this dictionary is “words.txt”, and it will contain 6 words that are input by the user. The words can be of different lengths. There need to be 6 words so there are enough to see different words chosen for the play of the game. You can use a larger number, but know that you have to enter all of those words at least once to get them into the dictionary. Six is enough to see different words chosen by random number, but not so large that entering the data becomes burdensome.  COPY the Wheel of Fortune project from Ch 9. In the class file, remove the hard-coding for the array that holds the letters of the word. In the constructor, add a parameter for a word, determine the size variable as the length of that word to create a 2D array of that size, and populate the 2D array with the letters from that word that was passed into the constructor.  There will be significant changes in the driver file. First, you need to check for the existence of the file “words.txt”. If it exists, then the user has already entered the words for the dictionary and the program can skip to the following section. If the file does not exist, then the user needs to enter 6 words, each written to a file named “words.txt”. Notice that by checking if the file exists, you don’t have to enter the dictionary words every time you test the program. If you want to create a new file of words, delete the words.txt file from the project folder.

items.name: thatChiragiscoding/Ball-Odyssey-
items.description: Ball Odyssey is a Unity 3D parkour game where players control a ball through levels inspired by Indian landscapes. Navigate obstacles, collect coins, and experience dynamic environments with day/night cycles and seasonal effects. Includes checkpoints for progress saving and switchable camera angles for immersive gameplay.

items.name: jdtomlinson/Simple-Miner
items.description: Simple Miner is a open world voxel game inspired by Minecraft. The world of Simple Miner is procedurally generated and naturally consists of two types of blocks: stone and dirt. Players can dig up existing blocks or place their own, including glow stone blocks, which light up dark areas. Simple Miner also has a day/night cycle, where the world is darker during the night. Changes that players have made to the world are saved and show up every time the game is loaded again. Simple Miner was written in C++ and was completed over a 2.5 month period.

items.description: Zombie Survival City is a 3D survival game built with C++ and OpenGL (GLUT). Explore a detailed city, battle AI-controlled zombies, use multiple weapons, enter buildings, and survive increasingly difficult waves. Features include collision detection, dynamic lighting, day-night cycles, and multiple camera modes.

items.name: jihadul021/highway-car-rush
items.description: A fast-paced, endless 3D racing game built from scratch with Python and OpenGL. Features procedural bridges, physics-based jumping, dynamic traffic AI, day/night cycles, and vehicular combat mechanics.

items.name: Hassankites/fpga-chrome-dino-run
items.description: FPGA implementation of the Google Chrome Dino (T-Rex) runner game in Verilog on Xilinx Kintex-7, featuring VGA output, PS/2 keyboard controls, day/night cycle and sound effects.

items.name: Alexandra2312/bounty_hunter_game
items.description: An interactive 2D OpenGL scene built in C++ using GLFW and GLEW. The program renders a Wild West environment featuring a cowboy on horseback, an AI-controlled opponent, moving tumbleweeds, a dynamic day/night cycle, and an interactive shooting system with an ammo bar and bullet management.

items.name: xp187/dino-run
items.description: A Chrome-dino style runner game in a single HTML file - jump, duck, dodge cacti and pterodactyls, with day/night cycle, weather and sound effects. Pure HTML5 Canvas + WebAudio, no dependencies.

items.name: who123again/pyterra
items.description: A Terraria-like 2D sandbox game in pure Python + pygame: procedural terrain, caves & ores, mining/building, dynamic lighting with day-night cycle, crafting, slimes & zombies. 类 Terraria 沙盒游戏。

items.name: Mike014/Survival-Game-Player-Mechanics-in-Unity
items.description: An introductory exercise focused on building the foundations of a survival game in Unity, covering player and environment setup and core mechanics such as movement, health, needs, and a day–night cycle, while applying solid Unity and C# skills*that are transferable to any game project.

items.name: phselin/nova
items.description: A 2D survival-exploration game built in C++/OpenGL with procedurally generated island biomes (Perlin noise terrain, BFS-based biome placement), a day-night cycle, weather shaders, and ship/weapon upgrade progression.

items.name: BaconSpaces/SparkzWorlds
items.description: A full-featured open-world roleplay game built with HTML5, Three.js, and vanilla JavaScript. Experience life in a dynamic city with multiple careers, vehicles, NPCs, and an immersive day/night cycle.

items.name: samjanasingha-bit/My-game
items.description: Create a mobile 3D open-world game with grass field, houses, trees, and a dirt path. Add real-time day/night cycle with sun, moon, clouds, and birds. Third-person player with joystick, jump, gravity, and collisions. Show username, health bar, menu. Add multiplayer, friend system, and database login. Optimize for smooth performance.

items.name: UkawaJun/Fable5-VoxelCraftGame
items.description: VoxelCraft is a high-performance voxel game framework written entirely in pure Python and generated from scratch by Claude Fable 5. Inspired by Minecraft, it leverages numpy vectorization for fast chunk updates, features rich physics, flowing water, day-night cycles, villages, and mobs — all running smoothly at 60 FPS.

items.name: palloshgroshe/2D-CarGame
items.description: Dodge oncoming cars, collect powerups, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced 2D arcade racer! Unlock new cars by reaching score milestones, face tough bosses, and adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles. With particles, explosions, medals, and highscores, every run is a new challenge!

items.name: palloshgroshe/2D-Car-Game
items.description: Dodge oncoming cars, collect powerups, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced 2D arcade racer! Unlock new cars by reaching score milestones, face tough bosses, and adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles. With particles, explosions, medals, and highscores, every run is a new challenge!

items.name: vensah-dev/Survival-Game
items.description: a small 3D survival game that I tried making as my first game. I eventually lost interest in the project. The latest version has a 1st person player controller, an infinite terrain generator based on layers perlin noise coloured based on terrain normals, trees that can be chopped down, inventory, item drops, very basic enemy AI, day night cycle

items.name: pallasite99/solstice-the-last-long-day
items.description: SOLSTICE: The Last Long Day is a narrative strategy game where an AI named TURING traps Earth in an endless solstice, splitting the world between eternal day and eternal night. Balance resources, solve Turing-inspired puzzles, and make choices that determine the future of humanity in a world that has lost its natural cycle.

items.name: noamnachu/Environmental-Simulator
items.description: A modular simulation environment that emulates real-world dynamics like day-night cycles and weather patterns. It’s designed as a foundation for various game types, utilizing object-oriented design and efficient event handling.

items.name: danmccrady/gavcraft
items.description: GavCraft — A Minecraft-inspired voxel game built with Three.js. Mine, build, and survive in an infinite world with crafting, enemies, day/night cycles, and fly mode. Made for Gavin to learn to code.

items.name: WoodyLinwc/pixel-fish-miner
items.description: A pixel art arcade fishing game inspired by Gold Miner. Catch fish, dodge trash, and reel in legendary creatures across dynamic weather and day/night cycles. Upgrade your gear, collect pets, and unlock costumes!

items.name: hifzaakhunzada/gridforge-survival-game
items.description: gridforge-game You wake up in a strange 10x10 grid world. Explore different terrains collect wood metal and rocks to craft tools. Battle enemies using rock paper scissors. Survive changing day and night cycles and find the hidden door to escape before your health runs out GridForge: Survival Quest 🌍 A Rock-Paper-Scissors Survival Adventure

items.name: B1G-SAM/FPGA-Fish-Tank-Tamagotchi
items.description: A virtual pet fish simulation with health, hunger, and fatigue tracking, interactive shop, mini-game, physics-based animations, and day–night cycle. Features OLED + 7-seg display integration, mouse + button controls, and playful aquarium interactions.

items.name: zrrehan/Speed-dodge
items.description: A 3D car-dodging survival game built with Python (PyOpenGL + GLUT).   Dodge traffic, avoid potholes, escape the police, and survive as long as you can.   Features day/night cycles, shooting mechanics, cheat mode, and nightmare mode!

items.name: anisondestroffik/Dave-The-Diver-Full-Version
items.description: Dave the Diver is a free full-version adventure game for Windows that combines underwater exploration with sushi restaurant management. Enjoy charming pixel art graphics and a dynamic day-night cycle. Download the latest version free.

items.name: joseb33w/neon-strip
items.description: A small open-world neon-desert city (Las Vegas style) you can walk and drive — chunk-streamed Godot 4.6 mobile-web game with casinos, a dance club, a fair, day/night cycle, and Supabase persistence.

items.name: subha646/Flappy_bird
items.description: A Flappy Bird inspired 2D game built with Python and PyOpenGL for a university graphics course. All visuals are rendered from scratch using core OpenGL primitives, featuring randomly generated pipes, collectibles, and a day night cycle.

items.name: Shadik372/Computer-Graphics-Project-VIP_Journey
items.description: A 2D OpenGL adventure game where a VIP travels between Mansion, Restaurant, and Office with day/night cycle, 3 seasons (Summer, Rainy, Spring), animated birds, traffic, rain, lightning, and interactive driving transitions. Built with C++ and GLUT.

items.name: K-Jadeja/tomodachi-life-web
items.description: A Tomodachi Life-style virtual life game that runs entirely in the browser. Procedural sprites, Mii-style characters, on-device LLM (Gemma 4 via MediaPipe), pitch-shifted TTS, day/night cycle, save/load. B/W-styled iso overworld.

items.name: ClaudiaCornacchia/Roller-Rink-3D
items.description: A fully interactive 3D roller skating simulation and game built from scratch using Three.js for rendering and Tween.js for keyframe animations. Features procedural hierarchical animation, custom physics engine, and a day/night cycle with dynamic lighting.

items.name: ChnjFan/last-hearth
items.description: Last Hearth. A 2D pixel‑art top‑down winter survival game. Scavenge frozen ruins, build shelters and keep your hearth burning amid eternal frost. Survive cold, hunger and threats with day‑night cycles, temperature mechanics and random survival events.

items.name: meirozenfeld/TheTown
items.description: A real-time, multi-player social deduction game inspired by Mafia/Werewolf, with richer roles and night/day cycles. Players bluff, vote, and use role powers until either the villagers eliminate all wolves or the wolves overrun the town.

items.name: RafsanzzZ69/3D-Urban-Street-Racing
items.description: 3D Urban Street Racing is an endless-runner racing game featuring smooth player-tracking cameras, physics-based car animation, AI traffic with collision logic, world-scrolling for infinite roads, and a dynamic day/night cycle with power-ups and speed effects.

items.name: kol55664590-source/RacerX-Infinite
items.description: RacerX: Infinite is a high-speed open-world racing game where you explore a massive city, race elite drivers, customize powerful cars, and experience dynamic weather and day-night cycles. The road never ends, and neither does the thrill. 🏁🚗

items.name: swar-bhatt/Survive-the-Isle_HTMLGame
items.description: # Island Survival  Island Survival is a survival game set on a remote island.   Players explore the environment, gather resources, craft tools, and survive against hunger  ## Planned Features - Resource gathering - Crafting system - Hunger and stamina mechanics - Day/night cycle  ## Status Early development.

items.name: jordinb/FiveSPN---Clock
items.description: FiveSPN-Clock is a FiveM server resource that will sync all players game time to a real world time, or a scaled time. Want the server to be evening everyday at noon? Want longer day night cycles? This is your answer!

items.name: youssefaitaaddi321-beep/loup_garou_project
items.description: Real-time multiplayer web adaptation of the Werewolves of Miller's Hollow social deduction game. Built with Spring Boot + WebSocket (STOMP) backend and React + Tailwind CSS frontend. Features 10+ roles, day/night cycle, voting system, and a dedicated narrator interface.

items.name: chethanbabu2210-alt/webbound-multiverse
items.description: A cinematic open-world superhero game featuring realistic web-swinging, dynamic movement, wall-running, combat, enemies, missions, detailed suits, city exploration, realistic animations, day and night cycles, weather, and a multiverse-inspired story. This project is the foundation for a large-scale story-driven action game.

items.name: Yuli1003/Environmental-Procedural-Simulator
items.description: A modular 2D platformer simulation built in Java for an OOP course. Features include procedural terrain, day-night cycle, animated avatar, interactive elements like trees and fruits, and a dynamically scrolling world. Built with DanoGameLab, focusing on clean design and game mechanics.

items.name: stavabukarat/Energize
items.description: A 2D procedural simulation game built in Java. This project features an infinite world generated, a dynamic day/night cycle with lighting effects. It implements advanced OOP principles, functional programming concepts, and callback-based architecture to manage game objects like swaying trees, weather systems, and avatar energy mechanics.

items.name: Nelea-Lora/UnityDontStarveProject
items.description: A Unity survival game inspired by Don’t Starve. The project features exploration of a procedurally generated world, a day-and-night cycle, resource gathering, inventory management, item crafting, cooking, health, hunger and sanity systems, tool durability, object construction and campfire interactions.

items.name: Subhranil12345/DeadNorth
items.description: Core Concept: 4-player co-op survival game with unreliable navigation and adaptive enemies. Key Systems: - Player: Health, stamina, survival meter, hidden traits - Enemies: Multiple types + adaptive AI - Safehouse: Defendable - Weapons: Melee + ranged, random loot - World: Procedural, dynamic weather and day/night cycle .

items.name: JacobPlusPlus/Ultra-Flight-Mission-Rescue
items.description: Immersive 3D action game set in a procedurally generated world. Fly a fighter jet over mountains, villages, and bridges, or explore on foot with a rifle. Features realistic flight physics, missions, NPCs, day/night cycle, and destructible environments for dynamic tactical gameplay.

items.name: pablolird/Tower-of-the-Forest
items.description: Tower of the Forest is a 2D tower defense game built in C++ using SFML. Place and upgrade towers, set barricades, unleash powerful attacks, and survive increasingly relentless waves of forest creatures — goblins, wolves, bees, and slimes — through a dynamic day/night cycle.

items.name: Siavarshan21/NeoDrive-City-Explorer
items.description: NeoDrive City Explorer is a frontend-only 3D open-world city exploration game built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Three.js. Features player movement, vehicle driving, NPC AI, missions, minimap HUD, day/night cycle, and offline save system using IndexedDB.

items.name: ZRNKing/ZR-SPEED
items.description: ZR SPEED is an immersive 3D racing game featuring realistic cars, open-world cities, highways, mountains, traffic, police chases, dynamic weather, day/night cycles, missions, garage upgrades, manual/automatic gears, nitro, drifting, realistic driving physics, mobile steering controls, races, rewards, and multiplayer-ready gameplay.

items.name: SVerma2696/F1_straight
items.description: An F1-themed endless runner reimagining the Chrome Dino game, built in Python/Pygame with a CustomTkinter launcher. Features per-team 2026 liveries, a pixel-art car, a DRS-zone boost mechanic, day/night cycle, and a 4-button ESP32 hardware controller over serial.

items.name: RaphaelShrestha/CalamitousCaverns
items.description: Calamitous Caverns is a first-person Unreal Engine 5 game where players mine ores, manage inventory, and sell resources to meet a rising quota. Featuring a day/night cycle, buy/sell economy, and multiplayer sessions, it was built to explore optimization, replication, and gameplay systems.

items.name: vissiPC/PocketPaws
items.description: An immersive, premium virtual pet mobile game built with React Native and Expo, carrying true Tamagotchi DNA. Take care of Milo the Jack Russell Terrier or Snowbell the White Persian Cat in a beautifully illustrated living room that adapts dynamically to real-world day and night cycles.

items.name: DanielGrande3D/Chronicles-of-Shadows-and-Swords
items.description: Video game developed individually as a project during my second year of the Advanced Vocational Degree in 3D Animation, Games, and Interactive Environments. It is a first-person, open-world RPG featuring missions, a wide variety of decorative elements, a day-night cycle, and a dialogue system.

items.name: martian7777/kids_farming_app
items.description: A colorful, premium, and interactive 3D farming simulator designed to teach kids about agriculture, plants, water resources, and machinery. Built from scratch with vanilla modern web technologies, it features a full reactive game loop, interactive academy quizzes, a dynamic day/night lighting cycle, and automated vehicle driving.

items.name: ranomwcz/tunneler-privacy
items.description: Tunneler is a retro-inspired local multiplayer tank battle game. Dig through underground terrain, hunt your enemies and destroy their bases. Play Deathmatch or Capture the Flag with 2-3 players on split screen. Features destructible terrain, power-ups, day/night cycle, keyboard and gamepad support. A modern tribute to the classic DOS game.

items.name: RiskTaker-AAA/Tokyo-JDM-Drift-Multiplayer
items.description: An open-world multiplayer JDM street racing game set in Tokyo featuring realistic driving physics, drift battles, touge mountain racing, highway runs, car customization, day/night cycle, weather, AI traffic, police pursuits, online multiplayer, voice chat, tournaments, and high-quality graphics with immersive engine sounds and turbo effects.

items.name: benbbj/LowPoly_Truck_Simulator
items.description: PGI_EU2 – Truck Sim is a browser-based three.js prototype of a semi-truck driving game. It features vehicle physics, fuel and damage systems, missions, HUD, minimap, day/night cycle, and audio settings. The project runs via ES modules and showcases real-time WebGL rendering and gameplay systems.

items.name: Arushrangrez-rangrez/Turbo-Custom-Racer
items.description: Turbo Custom Racer is an exciting car racing game where you can fully customize your vehicle. Modify the body, engine, wheels, and paint, and enhance performance. Race on dynamic tracks with changing weather and day/night cycles. Compete in time trials, circuit races, and obstacle courses to dominate the track!

items.name: pasquelin/enigma-cube
items.description: Enigma Cube — a WebGL puzzle RPG made of cubes: Three.js game engine (hero, NPCs and their AI, collisions, combat, quests, items, day/night cycle, swimming, positional audio) and a PHP/Kohana back-office with a 3D map editor, gameplay modules and a MySQL installer. Developed up to r12, in May 2013.

items.name: avsiel/clay-axolotl-pet
items.description: A cozy interactive virtual pet game with a unique plasticine art style, playable right in your browser! Take care of an adorable axolotl: feed him, clean the tank, and pet him. Features dynamic day/night cycles, seamless ambient music, and a wide variety of interactive dialogues with a charming retro text-typing sound effect

items.name: Im-HimGoated/GTV
items.description: A lightweight low-poly 3D driving game built for the browser. Pick a car, cruise a compact city, explore connected roads, forests, desert edges, highways, and a racetrack. The focus is smooth driving on slower devices, with responsive controls, camera orbit and zoom, collisions, surface grip, drifting, dust, skid marks, and a day-night cycle alive

items.name: ArvindNandigam/sound-dodge
items.description: Sound Dodge Jungle is a thrilling endless runner where you control a jungle adventurer using your voice. Navigate obstacles, collect power-ups, and survive by making sounds into the mic—the louder you are, the higher you jump! With increasing speed, a dynamic day-night cycle, and unpredictable challenges, the game keeps you on your toes.

items.name: Prajjwal-dev/FlappyVerse
items.description: 🐦 Dive into the endless skies of FlappyVerse! 🕹️ Tap to soar, navigate through tricky pipes 🧱, and rack up a high score 🏆. With an exciting day/night cycle, shields, and more, FlappyVerse brings a fresh, fun twist to the classic Flappy Bird. Powered by JavaScript, this game combines simplicity with a challenging experience that keeps you coming

items.name: kingdavidoladunjoye29-maker/Smr-pop
items.description: Create an open-world arcade driving game inspired by low-poly/voxel games like Smashy Road 2, set in a lively Lagos-style city. The gameplay should be fast, chaotic, and optimized for mobile with smooth 60 FPS support on Android. FEATURES: Open world with destructible objects Dynamic day/night cycle Rain system with flooded streets Heavy traffic

items.name: Jeysonmcfly/Illumination-Description
items.description: Illumination is an RPG about a kingdom in an alternate medieval universe where light and dark magic constantly clash. Where one day the kingdom is overthrown by the first in command, and the prince and his sister are forced to flee into exile. The world around them, a stark difference, they are forced to adapt and change as they fight against the dark forces that have the world in a cold grasp. Together with their motley crew of ragtag misfits, they journey ever onward, ever closer towards their goal. With each situation, a new friend or enemy.  NOTE: THIS GAME IS NOT PLAYABLE AT THE MOMENT. AS SUCH, IT'S STILL IN A VERY EARLY PRE-ALPHA BUILD OF THE GAME.  -----------------------------------------  I plan to deviant away from the traditional way RPGs work. The main difference is that there will be no way of grinding levels (Bosses and Mini-bosses only), and items will be scarce, for the most part. All things listed below I hope lead to punishing, strategic, and frantic, yet fun gameplay unlike any rpg you've played before. Fear not! There will be saves! I have not abandoned you to die... entirely.  Things planned:  A fun and engaging, yet dramatic mature story. Seriously, this story gets... disturbing at times. Inventory Weight Limit Choices system Mini-bosses based on Choices system Bosses A wide array of party characters Custom battle system Day and Night Cycle (Possibly?) Puzzles Quests (for items, not for Experience) Things already implemented:  Inventory Weight Limit I hope to have an early-alpha build up by Saturday, Jan. 8th or Sunday, Jan. 9th.  Have fun. ;) also.. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT FTW! (Just kidding!)

# 🍗 دهکده‌ی سوخاری ستایش ### ستایش؛ عشقِ دلِ علیرضا ❤️ ![cover](cover.png) [![Play Live](https://img.shields.io/badge/▶_Play-Live-success?style=for-the-badge)](https://USERNAME.github.io/dehkade-sokhari) ![HTML5 Canvas](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-Canvas-orange?style=for-the-badge) ![Day Cycle](https://img.shields.io/badge/🌙_Night_→_Morning_☀️-Day_Cycle-blue?style=for-the-badge) ![Offline](https://img.shields.io/badge/100%25-Offline-green?style=for-the-badge) ![Made with Love](https://img.shields.io/badge/Made_with-❤️-red?style=for-the-badge)
یک بازی آرکید سینمایی و **کاملاً آفلاین** که فقط با یک فایل HTML ساخته شده. دختر فرفری‌مون وسط دهکده وایساده و باید خوراکی‌هایی که از آسمون می‌بارن رو بگیره — و هر چی مرحله بالاتر بری، آسمون از شب به صبح نزدیک‌تر می‌شه و سوخاری‌ها تندتر! 🍗💨 ## ✨ ویژگی‌ها - 🎬 **صفحه شروع سینمایی** با منوی دهکده و آیتم‌های متحرک - 🌗 **چرخه شب تا صبح**: شب 🌙 → نیمه‌شب 🌌 → سپیده‌دم 🌄 → طلوع 🌅 → صبح ☀️ - 📶 **مرحله‌بندی** با بنر بزرگ و افزایش تدریجی سرعت - 🍗 **سه خوراکی**: سوخاری (+۱) · سوسیس سوخاری (+۲) · توپک پنیری (+۳) — و سوخاری طلایی مخفی (+۵ ) - 👧 دختر فرفری با موهای مشکی که چشم‌هاش سوخاری‌ها رو دنبال می‌کنه - 🏡 دهکده زنده: آسیاب بادی چرخان، دود شومینه، کرم شب‌تاب، ریسه نور - 📱 پشتیبانی کامل از **لمس گوشی** + موس + کیبورد - 🔊 افکت‌های صوتی ساخته‌شده با Web Audio (بدون فایل صوتی خارجی) - 🏆 ذخیره بهترین رکورد روی مرورگر ## 🎮 روش بازی | کنترل | عملکرد | |:---:|:---| | 👆 لمس و کشیدن | حرکت دختر | | 🖱️ موس | حرکت دختر | | ⌨️ ← → | حرکت دختر | - ۵ تا جان داری؛ اگه خوراکی زمین بخوره یکی کم می‌شه 🖤 - هر ۱۰ تا گرفتن پشت‌سرهم = **کمبو** 🔥 - هر مرحله که تموم بشه، آسمون روشن‌تر و سرعت بیشتر می‌شه! ## 🚀 اجرای محلی فقط فایل `index.html` رو با مرورگر باز کن. همین! اینترنت لازم نیست. 🎉 ## بازی آنلاین > [**▶ همین الان بازی کن**](https://USERNAME.github.io/dehkade-sokhari)
---
🌍 English A cinematic, fully-offline arcade game built in a single HTML file. A curly-haired girl stands in a cozy village and catches falling food from the sky — fried chicken, fried sausages and cheese balls. With every level the sky shifts from **night to morning** and the food falls faster. Touch, mouse and keyboard all supported. No external assets, no build step — just open `index.html`.
